title: Tech Note: The OPEN WEB URL Command
author: Steve Hussey
featured_technology: mailto: links with subject/body query parameters
URL percent-encoding for carriage return/line feed (%0D/%0A)

historical_commentary.text: Steve Hussey's note is a straightforward reference for 4D's OPEN WEB URL command, covering how to launch the user's default browser for http(s) sites, compose pre-filled e-mails via mailto: links (including percent-encoded line breaks in the body), connect to FTP sites, and open local HTML files as a lightweight context-sensitive help system. OPEN WEB URL remains part of the current 4D language and this technique still works exactly as described, though for building help systems specifically, many developers today would reach for 4D's built-in Help/Info features or a modern web-based help viewer rather than raw local file:/// links.
related_updates: OPEN WEB URL is unchanged and remains a standard 4D command for launching URLs in the user's default applications
